usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: One or more usernames or handles to check, e.g. acmecorp, myband, janedoe_art. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

categories.title: Site categories
categories.description: Optional. Any of: developer, social, video, music, gaming, writing, creative, other. Empty checks all 50 sites.

sites.title: Only these sites
sites.description: Optional. Site names, e.g. GitHub, Twitch, Bluesky. Empty checks every site.

onlyTaken.title: Only sites where it is taken
onlyTaken.description: Output only the sites that have an account with the username (profile finder). Off lists every site with taken, available or unknown (availability check).
